title: What time in your life did u visit mall world
content: I’ve noticed alot of ppl have said they’ve been visiting mall world forever and I wonder why because I’ve only had mall world dreams for about two years and I’m assuming it has to do something with my life the first time I had a visit to mall world I had just moved back with my mom from being in foster care it was pretty heavy but since then I’ve had so many crazy mall world experiences and have practically an alternate reality life same house same neighbourhood same goals and waking thoughts but in this alternated reality that I can interact with and remember I don’t understand why it started just recently I’ve always been a very vivid dreamer I’ve dealt with sleep paralysis lots in my childhood not so much now so I’m just curious as to why now and why us because certainly not everyone goes there if they have they would know it’s different then dreaming makes me wonder what u need to do or experience to get there.
